answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. Because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, an attacker who floods the jury also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes. Consider a ocean at the center, a jetty resting nearby, and a meadow beyond the hills: three anchors, none forged, all earned over time.
